# Poisoned [Condition]

*[Rules Glossary](../index.md) > [Conditions](index.md) | [D&D Beyond](https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/br-2024/rules-glossary#PoisonedCondition)*

While you have the Poisoned condition, you experience the following effect.

***Ability Checks and Attacks Affected.*** You have [Disadvantage](../D20-Tests/Disadvantage.md) on attack rolls and ability checks.
